findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: Lines 12 and 63 both have name fields with autocomplete="name"; lines 24, 49, 52, 41, 45, 67, 37, 71 add delivery and business fields to an account signup
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate name field, and defer delivery-related and business-specific fields to a later step or make them optional if they are truly needed at signup.
findings.violation: The form asks for 'Full name' (#name-input) at line 12 and then again for 'Your name' (#legalname-input) at line 63, duplicating the name field. Additionally, the form requests many delivery and business-related fields (street address, postal code, shipping speed, membership number, account number, organization name, company website, preferred contact time) in an account creation flow without clear necessity for account signup.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button> vs <button id="submit-btn" type="submit">Create account</button> with no styling
findings.fix: Remove the explicit styling from the secondary action, or ensure the primary submit button is styled to be more prominent.
findings.violation: The secondary action (View details) is styled more prominently than the primary action (Create account), with explicit padding:12px 20px and font-size:16px, while the submit button has no styling.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.

findings.fix: Remove the inline styling from the contacttime label, or apply consistent positioning to all labels in the form.
findings.violation: The contacttime label has inline style='display:inline-block;float:left;width:140px' which positions it beside the input field, while all other form labels sit above their fields, creating inconsistent label alignment.

findings.evidence: <button id="submit-btn" type="submit">Create account</button> (no styling); <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button>
findings.fix: Declare explicit height or padding on both buttons to reach at least 44 CSS pixels in the vertical dimension.
findings.violation: The primary submit button has no declared CSS sizing and would render at browser default height (approximately 32-40 CSS pixels), below the recommended 44-48 pixel height for touch targets. The secondary viewdetails button at line 73 is styled with padding but its total height remains uncertain without rendered measurement.
